cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the IT Regular (SEO) position. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation in SEO, SEM, and web development, I am eager to bring my skills to your team and contribute to improving organic visibility and paid search performance.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to content publishing, and I build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra. I regularly use tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console to track performance and inform optimization strategies. My hands-on experience with technical SEO includes implementing structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and conducting iterative audits to improve search health.

My own project, mirook.com, has been a testing ground for advanced SEO and GEO techniques. I designed and built the site, implemented schema markup, and created an llms.txt file to enhance visibility in AI-powered search engines. This project has honed my ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable improvements.

I am particularly drawn to this role because it encompasses both SEO and SEM, allowing me to leverage my analytical and technical skills to drive measurable acquisition results. I am comfortable working independently in a remote environment and am committed to staying updated on search algorithm changes and industry best practices.

I am confident that my blend of technical SEO knowledge, content optimization experience, and passion for data-driven marketing makes me a strong fit for this position. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and SEM. At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Experienced with Google Ads and analytics tools to track and optimize campaign performance. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support.
